race.comment: FIREBREAK (7) exits an Eagle Farm run, is third-up, and has two placings from three previous 1200m starts. A one-week back-up is a slight concern, but she has the fitness and distance credentials to contend. THINKER (12) poses a significant threat after chasing Spoilt Rotten at Toowoomba, having closed from well back at Gatton. She has placed at this distance plus the inside draw benefits her chances. BRASH MAGIC (3) resumes after six months with a trial win behind him. Can return on the right note. ZOUBUCA SHOTS (11) went forward and gave a great sight when third over 1100m at Gatton last time out. Yet to find winning form this prep but has been thereabouts with three placings from five starts. Don't underestimate.
